info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Delete Loan API
info.description: The Delete Loan API enables users to remove existing loan records from the system. By specifying a valid loan ID, consumers can efficiently manage their financial data and ensure that their loan portfolio remains up to date. This operation is particularly relevant for financial institutions and loan management services that require precise control over their loan entries. Typical use cases include closing a loan after full repayment or correcting erroneous entries. Integration with this API helps streamline loan administration practices.

delete.description: This operation allows you to delete a loan identified by its unique ID, permanently removing it from the system. Ensure you have the necessary permissions before attempting to delete a loan.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to specify the details required to delete the loan with the identifier LOAN-500045. It must conform to the expected schema to allow for a successful deletion.

204.description: Request completed successfully with no content returned.

DeleteLoanByIdRequest.description: Request body for DELETE operation on loan 500045. This string body represents the required payload for the operation.
